plugins.name: code-safely-plugin
plugins.description: Safety guardrails and convenience auto-approvals for Claude Code: blocks destructive commands, protects critical dotfiles and credentials, prevents secret leaks and force-pushes, and auto-approves read-only/test/build commands.

plugins.name: kanban-flow
plugins.description: Autonomous, card-driven kanban development: an orchestrator and specialist agents that run each backlog card through slice → design → implement → test → review, shipping design and implementation as two reviewable PRs per card.

plugins.name: github-app-identity
plugins.description: Give local automation dedicated GitHub App identities — one profile per bot, selected per clone: a directory-aware gh shim, token minter, and git credential helper make commits/pushes/gh act as the App, never falling back to personal credentials.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Skills for working more productively with Claude Code. 'handoff' distils the current session into a single self-contained document; 'continue' reads it back in a fresh session and proposes an approved plan to resume the work; 'task-observer' watches task sessions for skill-improvement opportunities and runs skill creation/refinement reviews; 'token-usage' reports token usage per model across all projects over a time window.

plugins.name: devtools
plugins.description: Developer-workflow automation. 'renovator' merges provably-safe green patch/minor Renovate dependency PRs and parks the rest; 'pr-reviewer' runs a three-lens agent panel over every other open PR and either requests changes with concrete recommendations or approves and merges.

plugins.name: engineering-standards
plugins.description: Assess a repository against the Home Projects Engineering Standards: classify it once (type, deployment target, database, recorded in .nyx.yml), then score every applicable criterion and write docs/assessment.md with category scores, maturity level, blocking gates and actions.
